title: Implement iOS Lock Down Profile for iOS iPhones in Microsoft Intune for Shared Devices
author_notes: Shaping note: the solution must cover how to USE, PROVISION, and LOG IN to BOTH a Shared device AND a Corporate device managed by Microsoft Intune.

Effort tier: T3 (lock-down configuration/restrictions profile for shared iPhones + dual provisioning models — shared no-user-affinity vs corporate user-affinity — plus enrollment, compliance, and end-user login/use flows).

Distinct from ios-iphone-shared-device-mode (IOSSDM = kiosk locked specifically to Cisco Webex). This product centers on the lock-down PROFILE itself and the dual shared-vs-corporate provisioning + login experience; do not duplicate the Webex-kiosk product. version_directive: New; branding: off (white-label).
hook: Lock down shared iPhones — and give staff a clear way to use both a shared and a corporate device
problem: Many organizations hand out two kinds of iPhone: shared devices that anyone on shift picks up and uses, and corporate devices assigned to one person. The shared ones need a real lock-down profile so they stay clean, consistent, and limited to what the job needs; the corporate ones need a lighter, user-owned experience — and staff need to know exactly how to provision, sign in to, and use each. Done ad hoc, shared phones drift, get tied to whoever set them up, and users are confused about which device does what. This solution delivers a repeatable iOS lock-down profile for shared iPhones in Microsoft Intune, alongside the provisioning and login model for both shared and corporate devices.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the shared-vs-corporate iPhone model, what an iOS lock-down profile is (device restrictions, optional kiosk single/multi-app, supervised controls), the two enrollment/provisioning models (no-user-affinity shared vs user-affinity corporate), and the end-user login/use experience for each.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra ID, Apple MDM Push (APNs) certificate, Apple Business Manager + ADE token, supervised devices, device/user groups, a shared sign-in account where used, a pilot group) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: identity & Apple connection baseline, the shared no-user-affinity ADE enrollment, the corporate user-affinity ADE enrollment, the lock-down device-restrictions (and optional kiosk) profile for shared devices, a lighter corporate baseline, compliance & access, then pilot, validate, and expand.

Use & Login Guide — how an end user picks up and uses a shared device (sign in to apps with the shared/managed account, hand-back/reset expectations) and how a user provisions and signs in to their own corporate device — the practical day-to-day for both.

5 PowerShell scripts — tenant/device readiness discovery, per-device lock-down + enrollment-model validation, a fleet shared-vs-corporate posture report, safe remediation of drifted devices, and a shared/corporate device-group builder.
short: A repeatable iOS lock-down profile for shared iPhones in Microsoft Intune — device restrictions plus optional kiosk — with the full provisioning and login model for both shared and corporate devices. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: A repeatable iOS lock-down profile for shared iPhones in Microsoft Intune — device restrictions plus optional kiosk — with the full provisioning and login model for both shared and corporate devices.
meta_title: iOS Lock Down Profile for Shared iPhones (Intune) — Shared & Corporate
meta_description: Lock down shared iPhones in Microsoft Intune (device restrictions + optional kiosk) and provision, sign in to, and use both shared (no user affinity) and corporate (user affinity) devices via Apple Business Manager + ADE. Self-guided, tested steps and scripts.
bottom_line: Shared iPhones locked down to exactly what the job needs, corporate iPhones kept light and user-owned, and staff who know how to provision, sign in to, and use both — managed at fleet scale in Intune, proven on a pilot before you scale.
